title: stanflow: quick tour
text: core packages attached, can generate, summarise, visualise draws immediately.
code: set.seed(0) draws <- as_draws_df(   matrix(rnorm(4000), ncol = 1, dimnames = list(NULL, "theta")) ) summarise_draws(draws, mean, sd, rhat, ess_bulk) #> # A tibble: 1 × 5 #>   variable    mean    sd  rhat ess_bulk #>   <chr>      <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>    <dbl> #> 1 theta    0.00750 0.990  1.00    4038. mcmc_hist(draws, pars = "theta") #> `stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value `binwidth`. log_lik <- matrix(rnorm(4000 * 10, -1, 0.2), ncol = 10) loo(log_lik) #>  #> Computed from 4000 by 10 log-likelihood matrix. #>  #>          Estimate  SE #> elpd_loo    -10.2 0.0 #> p_loo         0.4 0.0 #> looic        20.4 0.0 #> ------ #> MCSE of elpd_loo is 0.0. #> MCSE and ESS estimates assume independent draws (r_eff=1). #>  #> All Pareto k estimates are good (k < 0.7). #> See help('pareto-k-diagnostic') for details.

title: A Mildly Opinionated Stan Bayesian Workflow
text: NB: stanflow currently active development–breaking changes may made without warning, proper release (see v1.0.0 milestone). stanflow join stan-dev stable well. stanflow R package faciliting Bayesian Workflow (Gelman et al. 2020). Much like famous tidyverse package, stanflow metapackage installs attaches Stan R packages, serving one-stop-shop Bayesian modelling. stanflow draws heavy inspiration tidyverse, reuses portions codebase–however, stanflow eschews tidyverse packages (.e., purrr, dplyr, etc.) base R.

title: A Mildly Opinionated Stan Bayesian Workflow
text: Installing (attaching) stanflow installs (attaches) bayesplot, loo, posterior, projpred, shinystan stan_cite() scans directory (provided list files) find used Stan functions, outputs BibTeX correct citations every package function used. setup_interface() automatically handles installing/attaching compatible Stan backends: brms, cmdstanr, rstan, rstanarm, mild defaults. stanflow_update() attempts automatically update date packages, can optionally search dependencies’ dependencies. stanflow natively relies multiverse date stable releases (see stan_repos). functions, four heart stanflow probably use .

Defaults scan_skip_dirs(). ignore_unqualified_functions Defaults exports base R packages listed stdlib_funs(). Character vector function names ignore attributing (unqualified) calls. Calls like pkg::fun() ignored even fun ignore_unqualified_functions, since namespaced. use_knitr Logical. TRUE, parse .Rmd .qmd files knitr::purl(), resolves knitr features -house parser ignores, child documents. also comments eval=FALSE purl=FALSE chunks, usage goes unrecorded. Defaults FALSE. quiet Logical. TRUE, suppresses status messages. Defaults FALSE.
